artifact.name: Z-Girl v3.18 Human-Centered Commercial Foundation RC2

review.evaluator: Greene Media Studio governed production review
review.notes: RC2.5 promotes the owner-approved premium human-centered mockup direction into the actual product architecture. The homepage now uses the premium Real People / Real Support hero, eight human-support role cards, Human First / AI in service of the relationship block, and Schools/Families/Communities pathways. The Human Support page now extends the same visual system with role selection and a Parent deep-dive interaction surface rather than treating the mockups as reference-only art.

ai_uses.purpose: Human-centered experience architecture, visual-system implementation, adaptive support routing, commercial pathway design, copy adaptation, QA, and governed release preparation
ai_uses.user_or_production_value: AI accelerates conversion of approved creative direction into a consistent interactive product while trusted humans remain central to support and decision-making
ai_uses.human_oversight: Owner retains visual acceptance and final public-release approval; participant sharing remains controlled; human supporters retain real-world authority
ai_uses.provenance: Application implementation in lgreene2/zgirl-hero-coach; owner-approved premium mockup direction from current Greene Media Studio production review; candidate photography provenance remains recorded separately

automation.no_additional_automation_rationale: Customer entitlements, partner economics, fundraising activation, and public release remain governance decisions rather than automatic actions.

evidence: Approved premium mockup hierarchy is now represented in the real homepage and Human Support product surfaces
Eight role cards and the Parent deep-dive create an actual human-centered interaction system rather than static reference art
AI-assisted production translated approved creative direction into functional product architecture and adaptive support pathways
Human support remains central and participant autonomy is preserved across role selection and preparation flows
Homepage and Human Support page share one responsive product language
Public Demo security model is inherited from protected production main
Human role imagery is paired with readable labels and mobile snap navigation
Primary pathways remain keyboard-link based and preserve descriptive content
Z-Girl Hero Within identity is preserved while expanding the human-support experience
No governed character canon is redefined
Public Demo and metered-AI locks remain unchanged
Commercial and fundraising channels remain unactivated

exceptions: Candidate photography remains subject to final campaign-specific rights/model/property-release review where applicable.

This RC does not activate public commercial release, paid checkout changes, affiliate commissions, reseller discounts, public fundraising claims, institutional customer entitlements, or new live-data access. Explicit owner approval is required before merge/release.
